summary: A reconnect returned exactly what it contracts to return, including learning that had superseded the checkpoint's premise, and the participant did not notice.

prior_learning.why: reviewed learning newer than the checkpoint was returned on reconnect and never confirmed, so it is not a reuse instance; a retrieval nobody confirmed is exactly the case the finding below is about, and counting it as reuse would report this change as a success of the thing it is evidence against

refusal_or_degradation.what_happened: the reconnect was correct and unhelpful: it returned the superseding learning it contracts to return, and nothing in the response distinguished learning that contradicts the checkpoint from learning that merely follows it
refusal_or_degradation.detected_by: review of the pilot record afterwards, not by the participant at the time; recorded as an open finding rather than a defect, because the surface returned exactly what it contracts to return
